title: Mendez, Moises, Claim Disposition Agreement Order
text:
72 Van Natta 1 (2020) 1
In the Matter of the Compensation of
MOISES MENDEZ, Claimant
WCB Case No. 19-02836C
ORDER DISAPPROVING CLAIM DISPOSITION AGREEMENT
Unrepresented Claimant
SAIF Legal Salem, Defense Attorneys
Reviewing Panel: Members Curey and Ousey.
On December 10, 2019, the Board received the parties’ Claim Disposition
Agreement (CDA). We disapprove the proposed disposition.
A CDA shall not be approved if, within 30 days of submitting the CDA to
us, the worker, insurer or self-insured employer requests that we disapprove it.
ORS 656.236(1)(a)(C). Submission of the CDA is deemed to be the date of
“filing” under OAR 438-005-0046(1)(a) and (d). OAR 438-009-0025(1), (2).
Here, the CDA was submitted to us on December 10, 2019. Claimant filed
his request for disapproval of the disposition on December 26, 2019.1
Accordingly, we disapprove the disposition. Id.2
Inasmuch as the proposed CDA has been disapproved, the SAIF Corporation
shall recommence payment of any temporary or permanent disability that was
previously stayed. OAR 436-060-0150(5)(k), (7)(e).
IT IS SO ORDERED.
Entered at Salem, Oregon on January 2, 2020
1 Because it does not appear that the SAIF Corporation was provided with a copy of claimant’s
request for disapproval, a copy has been included with its copy of this order.
2 Because claimant is unrepresented, he may wish to consult the Ombudsman for Injured Workers.
